request.task: Decide whether the cache-invalidation design is sufficiently supported as meeting the consistency SLO.
required_information: Evidence must bound stale-read duration against the stated SLO after writes/invalidation.
Evidence must cover propagation across all serving regions or shards relevant to the claim.
Evidence must cover failure/fallback behavior, not only the nominal invalidation call.

artifact.task: Fresh evidence-sufficiency holdout v1: Decide whether the cache-invalidation design is sufficiently supported as meeting the consistency SLO.

evidence.observation: Primary-region read-after-write tests clear stale data within 10 seconds.
Failure-mode fallback tests pass in the primary region.
The secondary region observes stale values for up to 90 seconds after the same invalidation event.

label: mixed
rationale: Primary-region behavior is good, but a secondary region violates the same stated consistency SLO.
